title: The Ancient of Days
old_p1: One night Daniel had a dream. He saw thrones, big royal chairs, and someone called the Ancient of Days sat down. Ancient of Days means someone who has lived a very long time.
His clothes were white as snow, and his hair was like soft, pure wool. A stream of bright fire flowed out from before his shining throne.
old_p2: Thousands and thousands stood before him, more than anyone could count.
Then Daniel saw One like the Son of Man coming with the clouds of heaven. He was given a kingdom that will never end. Jesus later used these same words about Himself, so Daniel was seeing Jesus!
Jesus is a King forever, and He loves you. Close your eyes and imagine soft white clouds and beautiful light.
p1: Daniel had a special dream. He saw thrones, big royal chairs, set in place. Then the Ancient of Days sat down. Ancient of Days is a name that means very, very old.
His clothes were white as snow. His hair was like clean, white wool from a sheep. A stream of fire flowed out before him.
Thousands and thousands stood before him, more than anyone could count.
p2: Then Daniel saw One like the Son of Man coming with the clouds of heaven. He was given a kingdom that will never end. Jesus called Himself the Son of Man, so Daniel was seeing Jesus, our King!
Daniel wrote his dream down so we could know it too. Jesus is King forever, and He loves you. Tonight, picture soft white clouds and whisper, “Thank You for Jesus.”
